THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT 1. DAMAGES: $35,000.00 PRE-JUDGMENT INTEREST: $18,381.36 TOTAL AMOUNT OF $53,381.36 2. THE JUDGMENT AGAINST FRANK J. FERRIS IS BASED ON CONCEALMENT OF FACTS FROM PLAINTIFF, A SPECIES OF FRAUD, WHICH WAS PROVEN BY CLEAR AND CONVINCING EVIDENCE SUCH THAT ENTITLES PLAINTIFF TO AN AWARD OF PUNITIVE DAMAGES IN THE AMOUNT OF $0. (ZERO) 3. THE TRANSFER OF REAL PROPERTY BY FRANK J. FERRIS AND HIS WIFE ON FEBRUARY 20, 2008, TO THE TRUSTEES OF THE FRANK J. FERRIS AND MARILYN S. FERRIS TRUST DATED JULY 29, 1998 WAS TO HINDER, DELAY AND DEFRAUD PLAINTIFF JASON GRAZIANO. THE TRANSFER WAS MADE BY GRANT DEED RECORDED IN THE COUNTY OF SACRAMENTO AT BOOK 20080220 AND PAGE 0828 AND THE PROPERTY WAS DESCRIBED THEREIN AS "LOT 402, PLAT OF WRIGHT & KIMBROUGH, ARDEN PARK VISTA UNIT NO. 2, FILED IN THE OFFICE OF THE SACRAMENTO COUNTY RECORDER'S OFFICE ON FEBRUARY 23, 1964, IN BOOK 23 OF MAPS, MAP NO. 4" ACCORDINGLY, SAID TRANSFER IS A FRAUDULENT TRANSFER AND IS HERBY VOIDED AND SET ASIDE. 4. PLAINTIFF IS AWARDED HIS COSTS IN THE AMOUNT OF $722.38.
ABSTRACT OF JUDGMENT ISSUED TO PLAINTIFF GRAZIANO, JASON
CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE OF MAY-01-2013 IS OFF CALENDAR, JUDGMENT ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
